results.title: Drizzle ORM + better-sqlite3 CRUD

results.title: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-zod validated inserts on SQLite
results.summary: Generate Zod insert and select schemas from Drizzle tables with drizzle-zod, refine them, and validate input before inserting into SQLite.

results.title: Hono + Drizzle ORM + SQLite REST API (Vitest)
results.summary: CRUD REST API in Hono backed by Drizzle ORM on better-sqlite3, with Zod validation, tested with Vitest and app.request().

results.title: Auth.js Drizzle adapter on PGlite Postgres (database sessions)

results.title: Drizzle ORM migrations on PGlite (in-memory Postgres)

results.title: Drizzle ORM + PGlite in-memory Postgres
results.summary: Real Postgres semantics in tests with no server: Drizzle ORM on PGlite (WASM Postgres) with relations, returning() and transactions.

results.title: Prisma 7 + SQLite via better-sqlite3 adapter
results.summary: Prisma Client 7 with the better-sqlite3 driver adapter, schema push and relational queries on a local SQLite file.

results.title: Alembic autogenerate compare_metadata drift check against SQLite
results.summary: Declare SQLAlchemy 2 models with a naming convention, then detect schema drift offline by diffing the live SQLite schema against the metadata with Alembic compare_metadata.

results.title: Prisma 7 + SQLite: nested writes, interactive transactions and unique errors
results.summary: Prisma Client 7 on SQLite (better-sqlite3 adapter): nested creates, an interactive $transaction that rolls back, and handling P2002 unique-constraint errors.

results.title: Tortoise ORM relations and filters on sqlite under pytest-asyncio
results.summary: Model foreign keys, reverse and many-to-many relations in Tortoise ORM, then exercise select_related, prefetch_related, dotted filters, distinct and annotate counts offline on in-memory sqlite.
